Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover falls within five of the item size, so bins that leave almost exactly one more item-sized space outrank tighter ones. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when such a near-complementary bin exists. It may help by creating bins ready for one more identical item, or fail because the five-wide window is arbitrary and may reward loose bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (60 if r - item >= item - 5 and r - item <= item + 5 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
